## Personality

Gertie Pye is known for her habit of arriving late, a behavior that others spitefully attribute to a desire to make her entrances more effective. Additionally, she and her sisters carry a reputation for being cheats.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035)_
